keynoteProfiles.attendeeValue: His expertise offers a practical perspective on taking low-carbon cement from research into production and construction, helping researchers and engineers connect material innovation with real applications.
keynoteProfiles.bio: A co-developer of Limestone Calcined Clay Cement (LC3), Fernando Martirena works on low-carbon binders, calcined clays and their industrial implementation. He brings research and consulting experience in turning sustainable construction materials into practical solutions.
keynoteProfiles.name: Dr. Fernando Martirena
keynoteProfiles.role: Head of LC3 Technical Resource Centre Latin America · Principal Consultant

keynoteProfiles.attendeeValue: Her expertise helps delegates assess both the environmental benefits and economic case for low-carbon cement, supporting more informed decisions about materials, investment and sustainable construction.
keynoteProfiles.bio: Sofía Sánchez Berriel holds a PhD in Economics and specializes in the environmental and economic assessment of low-carbon cement. Her LC3 work connects life cycle assessment, eco-efficiency and investment evaluation to help assess sustainable construction options.
keynoteProfiles.name: Dr. Sofía Sánchez Berriel
